# anthropic_workspace_member (Data Source)

Retrieves a single member of a Claude Console workspace (`GET /v1/organizations/workspaces/{workspace_id}/members/{user_id}`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) Identifier of the user (`user_...`).
- `workspace_id` (String) Identifier of the workspace (`wrkspc_...`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier (`workspace_id/user_id`).
- `type` (String) Object type (`workspace_member`).
- `workspace_role` (String) Workspace role of the user.
